verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a first-party disputes page saying it will "facilitate your dispute management step-by-step," which implies a guided dispute-handling process. Nothing in the pack shows how evidence is submitted or how dispute status is tracked to resolution. missing for 10: documented structured evidence submission (fields, file uploads, API or dashboard), dispute lifecycle states and status tracking, dispute-specific events or notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.
